summary: When I wanted to move all my classes onlien I started with WordPress, when I moved to straight HTML I wanted metadata, I looked at RDFD, I looked at all the learning vocabularies in schema.org...I couldn't do any of it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: When I wanted to move all my classes onlien I started with WordPress, when I moved to straight HTML I wanted metadata, I looked at RDFD, I looked at all the learning vocabularies in schema.org...I couldn't do any of it.
